title: From biopolymers to Pickering emulsions: a green chemistry strategy to replace microplastics in next-generation cosmetics

With the rising interest in eco-safe cosmetic products due to ongoing governmental restrictions and growing public concern regarding the effects of microplastics, research into biodegradable alternatives from renewable materials has been accelerated.
